craft_notes: Song p02 opens: sthayin sama; verse color = thought-free shining (the principle stated before its unfolding). Sanskrit: sarva-vikalpa-vihīnaṃ ... yat paratattvaṃ tasmin vibhāti — the relative yat suspended, resolved in tasmin (therein). Firing: (a) adjective-procession (all/thought-free/pure/peaceful/rise-free) -> kept as drumbeat adjectives, no verb till line 2; (b) ṣaṭtriṃśad-ātmakam = 'thirty-six-SELFed/natured' — ātmaka suffix restored as 'thirty-six-fold' (L3 dropped it; same ids, re-grounding); (c) tasmin (therein) containment -> close on 'within' (world held inside = santa settling inward). Dash suspends the attributes; line 2 gathers them into the principle.

craft_notes: Color = mutual mirroring. Sanskrit: yadvat... vibhāgena eva ca parasparam darpaṇād api ca — 'in-division indeed, mutually, from-mirror too'. Firing: (a) nagara-grāma-ādi (town-village-etc.) catalogue kept bare; (b) avibhāgi (undivided) vs vibhāgena (in division) paradox left standing across the dash; (c) close on 'too' — the trailing inclusiveness (each from each AND from the mirror too) is the doctrine: mutuality PLUS source. End-weight 'too' deliberately. 'many' for citram kept (frozen; citra's wonder-sense lives in the image itself).
